name: cache_tier_selector
description: Buys the cheapest prompt-cache lifetime for a conversation based on how long it actually goes idle. Decides once per cache prefix and never changes its mind, because changing a breakpoint marker invalidates the entry it is protecting.

permissions.name: env.host_call.torana_cache_pricing
permissions.description: Read this provider's cache prices and lifetimes to choose a tier

permissions.name: env.state_get
permissions.description: Read the tier already chosen for this cache prefix

permissions.name: env.state_set
permissions.description: Remember the chosen tier so it stays identical across turns

permissions.name: env.now
permissions.description: Measure how long a conversation has been idle

permissions.name: env.host_call.torana_plugin_counter
permissions.description: Report how many tier decisions were made
